name: Built Robotics Exosystem
summary: A bolt-on kit for 15–50 ton excavators that digs cable trenches on solar sites on its own from a GPS plan; the machine can still be driven by hand.

germany.statusNote: Not offered in Germany: Built says it currently supports robot deployments only in the United States and Australia; no European office, dealer or customer found. The kit is rented, not sold: in 2022 Built charged a monthly fee per machine plus hourly usage fees.

priceOther.market: US rental per machine and month, plus hourly usage fees that vary by location (TechCrunch, April 2022)

notes: Retrofit kit only: the customer supplies the crawler excavator and bucket; the kit mounts on the counterweight and can be removed.
Built's current offer is trenching for DC and AC cable runs on solar farms; earlier units dug wind-turbine foundations and pipeline trenches.
Works inside a GPS geofence with people kept out of the autonomous zone; Built monitors the robots remotely.

Whether trenching is still actively marketed: since 2023 Built's R&D focus is the solar pile driver (WIRED, April 2023).
